name: stack-stats-vscode
description: Local-first developer activity analytics: coding time, sessions, languages, projects and streaks. Optional private sync and a public developer profile.

commands.title: Stack Stats: Retry Local Daemon Sync
Stack Stats: Open Advanced Tracking Settings
Stack Stats: Disconnect All Agent Integrations
Stack Stats: Advanced: Show Manual Agent Integration Setup
Stack Stats: Set Up Agent Integrations (Legacy)
Stack Stats: Connect Stack Stats Account

stackStats.enabled.description: Collect local activity. Pause Tracking turns this off in every window: nothing is collected while paused, whatever your tracking level. Existing history is kept.

stackStats.collectActivityTimeline.markdownDescription: **Hourly activity patterns.** When during the day you code, plus typing detail such as characters and undo/redo counts. Timestamped 15-second records without any text, stored on this device. Uploaded only if you also turn on hourly sync. Part of your [tracking level](command:stackStats.changeTrackingLevel).
stackStats.collectActivityTimeline.description: Hourly activity patterns: when during the day you code, plus typing detail such as characters and undo/redo counts. Timestamped 15-second records without any text, stored on this device. Uploaded only if you also turn on hourly sync. Part of your tracking level (Stack Stats: Change Tracking Level).

stackStats.collectEditorEvents.markdownDescription: **Editor workflow.** Saves, switches between files, window focus, and files created, renamed or deleted in VS Code. Event counts and private file IDs, never file names or contents. Stored on this device. Part of your [tracking level](command:stackStats.changeTrackingLevel).
stackStats.collectEditorEvents.description: Editor workflow: saves, switches between files, window focus, and files created, renamed or deleted in VS Code. Event counts and private file IDs, never file names or contents. Stored on this device. Part of your tracking level (Stack Stats: Change Tracking Level).

stackStats.collectWorkflows.markdownDescription: **Tasks and debugging.** Build and test task runs and debug sessions started in VS Code: task type, exit code and timing. Never commands, arguments, output or debug configuration. Stored on this device. Part of your [tracking level](command:stackStats.changeTrackingLevel).
stackStats.collectWorkflows.description: Tasks and debugging: build and test task runs and debug sessions started in VS Code: task type, exit code and timing. Never commands, arguments, output or debug configuration. Stored on this device. Part of your tracking level (Stack Stats: Change Tracking Level).

stackStats.collectDiagnostics.markdownDescription: **Problem counts.** Error and warning counts for files you change. Counts by severity only, never messages or code. Stored on this device. Part of your [tracking level](command:stackStats.changeTrackingLevel).
stackStats.collectDiagnostics.description: Problem counts: error and warning counts for files you change. Counts by severity only, never messages or code. Stored on this device. Part of your tracking level (Stack Stats: Change Tracking Level).

stackStats.collectFilesystem.markdownDescription: **External file changes.** Changes made outside the editor by terminals, scripts, agents or checkouts, with the writer unknown. Change counts, and line counts for files open in VS Code; never file contents. Never counted as coding time. Stored on this device, never synced. Part of your [tracking level](command:stackStats.changeTrackingLevel).
stackStats.collectFilesystem.description: External file changes: changes made outside the editor by terminals, scripts, agents or checkouts, with the writer unknown. Change counts, and line counts for files open in VS Code; never file contents. Never counted as coding time. Stored on this device, never synced. Part of your tracking level (Stack Stats: Change Tracking Level).

stackStats.collectGit.markdownDescription: **Git activity.** Branch switches and new commits, checked at most once a minute in trusted workspaces. Private commit and branch IDs and changed-line counts; never commit messages, authors or remote URLs. Stored on this device. Part of your [tracking level](command:stackStats.changeTrackingLevel).
stackStats.collectGit.description: Git activity: branch switches and new commits, checked at most once a minute in trusted workspaces. Private commit and branch IDs and changed-line counts; never commit messages, authors or remote URLs. Stored on this device. Part of your tracking level (Stack Stats: Change Tracking Level).

stackStats.collectAgentActivity.markdownDescription: **Agent activity.** Labels changes and runs from agents you connect in the Stack Stats **Agents** view, such as Claude Code or Codex. Connecting is always a separate, confirmed step. Turning this off ignores every connected agent without removing its hook. Needs **External file changes**. Stored on this device, never synced. Part of your [tracking level](command:stackStats.changeTrackingLevel).
stackStats.collectAgentActivity.description: Agent activity: labels changes and runs from agents you connect in the Stack Stats Agents view, such as Claude Code or Codex. Connecting is always a separate, confirmed step. Turning this off ignores every connected agent without removing its hook. Needs External file changes. Stored on this device, never synced. Part of your tracking level (Stack Stats: Change Tracking Level).

stackStats.allowAttributionReports.markdownDescription: **Reports from other extensions.** Lets cooperating extensions label your edits as human- or AI-made. Labels are claims, not proof. Needs **Hourly activity patterns**. Stored on this device. Part of your [tracking level](command:stackStats.changeTrackingLevel).
stackStats.allowAttributionReports.description: Reports from other extensions: lets cooperating extensions label your edits as human- or AI-made. Labels are claims, not proof. Needs Hourly activity patterns. Stored on this device. Part of your tracking level (Stack Stats: Change Tracking Level).

stackStats.includeProjectNames.description: Include workspace folder display names in future activity metadata. Existing history is not rewritten.

stackStats.excludeFiles.description: Additional excluded file globs (*, ** and ?). Applied before all collectors and session tracking. Built-in secret/generated-file exclusions always apply.

stackStats.excludeProjects.description: Exclude workspace/repository roots by full-path or folder-name glob. Existing history is retained.

stackStats.rawRetentionDays.description: At startup, remove local telemetry batches delivered more than this many days ago. 0 retains indefinitely. Undelivered telemetry, session history and daemon SQLite are preserved.

stackStats.agentIntegrations.claudeCode.description: Managed by Connect / Disconnect in the Stack Stats Agents view (Stack Stats: Manage Agent Integrations). While on, Stack Stats accepts signals from its Claude Code hook: agent runs and agent-reported file changes as metadata only, with no prompts, responses, commands or file contents. Turning this off pauses labeling without removing the hook; Disconnect removes it. Local only; never synced. Agent time never counts as coding time.
stackStats.agentIntegrations.claudeCode.markdownDescription: Managed by **Connect / Disconnect** in the Stack Stats **Agents** view ([Manage Agent Integrations](command:stackStats.manageAgentIntegrations)); you normally never change this directly. While on, Stack Stats accepts signals from its Claude Code hook: agent runs and agent-reported file changes as metadata only, with no prompts, responses, commands or file contents. Turning this off pauses labeling without removing the hook; **Disconnect** removes it. Local only; never synced. Agent time never counts as coding time.

stackStats.syncHourlyActivity.description: Include private UTC hourly activity aggregates when Profile Sync is enabled and the server supports the richer contract. This can reveal work schedules. Hourly data exists only while Hourly activity patterns is part of your tracking level. Public sharing remains a separate choice. Disabling queues replacements without hourly data; existing server data changes only after successful sync.

stackStats.showStatusBar.description: Show Stack Stats in the status bar. Hiding it does not pause tracking.

stackStats.inactivityTimeoutMinutes.description: End the current session after this many minutes without edits. Changes apply immediately and may close an idle session. This does not change the 60-second active-time evidence gap.

scripts.build: esbuild src/extension.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:vscode --outfile=dist/extension.cjs && esbuild src/agent-hook.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/agent-hook.cjs && esbuild src/uninstall.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/uninstall.cjs
